newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says calls on LTCB to beef up overseas control.
newsitem.headline: MOF says calls on LTCB to beef up overseas control.

text.p: The Finance Ministry said on Friday that it had called on the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan to beef up internal risk controls at its overseas branches following a finding that the bank failed to report unauthorised trades in New York.

In August, the bank agreed to a $1 million settlement with U.S. regulators for failing to report unauthorised trades in bonds issued by the U.S. government-sponsored Federal National Mortgage Association. The fine, issued by New York State's banking office, was the latest example of a series of oversight problems by Japanese financial firms.
